verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows only an upgrade guide and an `ng update` command that updates workspace dependencies. These are adjacent upgrade tooling, not a documented API versioning scheme or deprecation policy. Nothing describes deprecation windows, versioning guarantees or stability commitments, so this applicable axis gets no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Check out our upgrade guide to find out the best way to upgrade your project.
Updates your workspace and its dependencies. See the Update Guide.
